SoftwareUpcoming

Ansys (Synopsys)

HFSS

Ansys HFSS supports high-frequency electromagnetic simulation for antennas and electronic systems.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Create a high-frequency model

Start from the device geometry, materials and frequency or operating range. In the intended HFSS preview, create a high-frequency model; the visible result is an electromagnetic model with regions and conductors identified. Review material properties, units, symmetry and geometric fidelity before accepting or exporting it.

Configure ports and sweeps

Begin with the selected excitations, ports and sweep controls. In the intended HFSS preview, configure ports and sweeps; the visible result is a configured solve state with boundaries and source definitions visible. Review reference directions, mesh refinement and solution setup before accepting or exporting it.

Review S-parameters and fields

Use the field solution and derived performance quantities. In the intended HFSS preview, review S-parameters and fields; the visible result is field plots, losses or network results linked to the selected design. Review convergence, energy balance, sweep resolution and design limits before accepting or exporting it.
